name: Rose in Bloom
source:
A cute visual novel about a girl named Rose. She likes to paint and stay inside. one day, there's a knock at the door. 

[From [url=https://jellicube.itch.io/rose-in-bloom]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部讲述女孩萝丝的可爱视觉小说。她喜欢画画，也喜欢待在室内。某天，门外传来了敲门声。

（来源：[url=https://jellicube.itch.io/rose-in-bloom]itch.io[/url]）
